player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhakataetae {player_id} i **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tukua tō kowhiringa hei **[macro  micro]** (e rua tau 0-8):
• *macro*  = ko hea te papa iti e tākaro ana koe
• *micro* = ko hea te māka e roto i taua papa iti
Tauira `[7 8]` ➜ whakanoho tō tohu i te papa iti 7, māka 8, ā,
whakamārō tō hoa kia tākaro i te papa iti 8 a muri.

Ko koe `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Me neke ki te ahua [macro micro] me nga nama 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Me tau ngā taupū ki waenganui i te 0 me te 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Ko te micro_board, rarangi, me ngā rārangi kei waho o te awhe.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Me tākaro te kaitakaro i roto i te poari moroiti e whai ake nei.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Kua riro kē te poari iti.

game_action.played: Kaiwhaiwhai {player_id} i whakatinana ki te papa iti {macro_idx}, ko te kokonga {micro_idx} (rarangi {row}, kohanga {col}). Me whakatinana a Kaiwhaiwhai {opponent_id} inaianei ki {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Ka wikitoria te kaitākaro {player_id} i a Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
